accepted_result: four paged KV-cache shapes passed CPU-vs-hybrid coverage-output equivalence
interpretation: The paged KV-cache harness supports the existing condition: many independent states amortize launch overhead and are the fast class; single-state repeated launches remain much weaker than many-state shapes.
weakest_point: This still does not distinguish LLM serving prefill from decode. The current harness has cache-like state traffic, but not separate many-token prefill and one-token decode phases.

next_selected_gap.reason: Prefill/decode separation is the next serving-specific condition to measure before moving to full ITA/MHA, quantized KV-cache, or resident execution.
next_selected_gap.expected_scope: reuse the paged KV-cache overlay shape but define separate prefill-like many-state/bulk append and decode-like repeated one-token read/append phases

required_non_claims: not low-precision or compressed KV cache
